text: Added a free tools page with downloadable planning spreadsheets for coordinators just starting out.
Your agents can now connect their own Claude to see just their own files, with you deciding per client whether they can look, send you requests to approve, or make changes themselves.

A transaction's money is now split into Invoicing, what the client owes you, and Payouts, what you owe the people who worked the file, with rates, approvals and payments all handled on the file itself.
Connect Claude to your workspace and ask what is closing, what is overdue, or who the lender is on a file, and with write access turned on it adds tasks, logs notes, and moves a status for you.

A private lender's file now shows the loan itself — amount, rate, term, LTV against the appraisal and LTC against the price, the carry, and who is borrowing — beside the documents going to underwriting.
Settings is now grouped into labelled sections, switching something off no longer shuffles other sections around the page, and the Handbook explains what each of its switches turns off.
